Hi Marta — quick follow-up from Redwood controls team.

1) Audit period: our latest Type II covers Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 30, 2026. We can issue a bridge confirmation for the period Oct 1, 2025 — present with the standard phrasing confirming no material changes to control environment since the last audit period. If you prefer Jan—Sep 2026 specifically, we can tailor wording but will still reference the underlying attestation period.

2) Access & gating: Full PDF is gated and issued to an authorized security contact after NDA countersign. We generally do not allow unattended downloads — options: secure view-only copy in GDrive with logging, or in-person/remote walkthrough with evidence excerpts. Vanessa will propose scheduling.

3) NDA & turnaround: I'll attach the bridge template and suggest using DocuSign for countersignature. Once we have a countersigned NDA, we aim to issue the summary + bridge within 48 hours and the gated PDF within 5 business days (subject to legal review).

Proposed next step: Marta, could you confirm the authorized reviewer(s) and whether you accept a view-only Drive link?
